THE SMALL PRINT

A little clarity
about privacy.

Your Toolbox favorites

The Toolbox stores saved resource IDs in local storage in your browser. There is no portfolio account and favorites are not sent to a portfolio database. If storage is unavailable, favorites work for the current visit only. Clearing this site’s browser data removes them.

Export and import

Exporting favorites creates a JSON file on your device. Importing reads the file in your browser and saves matching resources locally. Imported files are not uploaded to a server.

Fonts and links

Fonts and images used in this portfolio are served with the site. It does not load analytics, advertising trackers, or external font services. External links lead to websites with their own privacy practices.

Hosting

The hosting service may process technical information needed to deliver the site, including network requests. ChatGPT Site access may require sign-in according to the site’s sharing settings.

Get in touch

You can find me on GitHub.
